observer: George B. McClellan, dispatch to Halleck
evidence: Credits conspicuous management of the cavalry withdrawal from Harpers Ferry and recommends a major brevet.
limit: [I] Role-bounded execution appraisal. Recommendation is not proof that the brevet was granted, nor army-level competence or battlefield nerve.

evidence: Specifically credits gallant bridge defense and a vigorous flank charge at Sharpsburg.
